'''"Deadeye" Dortho''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a weapons vendor in [[Mos Ila]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="location" />
